items.title: alibaba/open-code-review
items.content:
Secure, fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in multi-language ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.

items.contentSnippet:
Secure, fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in multi-language ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.

Stars: 36473

items.creator: alibaba

summaries.zh: 阿里巴巴开源的代码审查工具 open-code-review，以快速高效著称，并在大规模实践中得到验证。该工具采用确定性管道与 LLM Agent 结合的混合架构，能提供精确的行级评论。它内置多语言规则集，覆盖 NPE、线程安全、XSS 及 SQL 注入等问题，并兼容 OpenAI 和 Anthropic。项目基于 Go 语言，目前 GitHub 星标数已超 2.5 万。
summaries.en: Alibaba's "open-code-review" is a fast, efficient code review tool designed for large-scale use. It utilizes a hybrid architecture combining deterministic pipelines with an LLM Agent to deliver precise line-level comments. The tool features built-in rules for detecting security vulnerabilities and code issues, such as XSS, SQL injection, and thread-safety problems. Written in Go, it is compatible with OpenAI and Anthropic models. The project has gained significant traction on GitHub, boasting over 25,000 stars and 1,850 forks.

It features a versatile interface supporting multiple AI providers, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and Azure. Key functionalities include AI model switching, Agents, Code Interpreter, DALL-E-3 integration, and secure multi-user authentication. The project has gained significant popularity on GitHub, accumulating over 44,000 stars and 9,000 forks, highlighting its robust capability as a customizable AI chat platform.
